latest.title: On parrots and vibe coding
latest.excerpt: Engineers can sound right and move fast by delegating everything to LLMs, but not without consequences.
latest.preview: Vibe coding is turning some engineers into parrots. The sound is right. The demo works, the tests are green, it is live and nobody is complaining. Then you ask about the problem next door, the one shaped almost the same, and the fluency drains out of the room. I ship with LLMs and review their output every day, which is...
